VERDICT: LGTM

The change slots cleanly into an established pattern and adds nothing out of place:

- `Owner.membershipTier(Integer, String)` is a static derivation method sitting right alongside its siblings `householdId(...)` and `membershipNumber(...)`, with matching Javadoc style ("deterministic in those two fields"). The derivation logic lives in the domain model, which is where the existing derived fields put it.
- `OwnerMapper.formatMembershipTier(owner)` mirrors `formatMembershipNumber`/`formatHouseholdId` exactly — same null-guard, same delegation to the `Owner` static method, same `@Mapping(... expression ...)` wiring. No logic is duplicated; the mapper stays a thin adapter and the model owns the rule.
- The `openapi.yml` entry is added next to `membershipNumber` with the same `readOnly`/`title`/`description`/`example` shape used by the neighboring derived fields.

Logic is in the right unit, nothing is duplicated, and neither `Owner` nor `OwnerMapper` is turning into a catch-all — each just gains one more member of an existing family. A maintainer of this codebase would find it natural.
